mod.desc:
# SuperBLT Beta for 64-bit PAYDAY 2

This is a beta release of SuperBLT, ported to the 64-bit release of PAYDAY 2.

While most of the functionality is working, a few things aren't finished yet:

* XAudio: **CURRENTLY WORKS**. This is in the process of having the backend be ported to play all audio via the game's native WWise audio engine, but this will not impact how mods work or are made.
* Misc. recent features from the 32-bit DLL: these were lost due to the history of the 64-bit port, which was forked from RAID BLT. Some changes were made to SuperBLT after RAID BLT forked from it, and these haven't been ported forwards yet.
* DLL Plugins: completely untested, may or may not work. No stable API yet.

# Installation instructions

Download the ZIP, and copy the DLL into your game folder. The README.txt file contains instructions on this.

If you are updating from a 32-bit SuperBLT installation, delete the 'base' folder inside the 'mods' folder. This will be automatically re-downloaded when you start the game for the first time.

{#00ff00}(Autoupdates have been changed from Dropbox to MWS in r424 - If you are having issues downloading updates in-game, please reinstall EHI)

**Minimum game version required: 1.0.0-158409 (Update 247)
Minimum SuperBLT version required: v1.5.0 (Lua) and [4.0.1-beta](https://modworkshop.net/mod/58342) (DLL)
Minimum EHI version to sync data to other EHI players: r427**
**!!! Failing to meet the minimum requirements will cause crashes in-game !!!**

Shows trackers for various heist related gameplay elements
- Waiting for a van/heli/boat
- Waiting for a C4
- Waiting for a thermite to finish
- Achievements*
- Achievements with progress (e.g.: "Another Way Out" achievement in Hell's Island)
- A chance for something to happen (e.g.: teargas, cooking chance)
- Mission XP Overview
- Buffs (skill or perk) and color them based on their action in-game
- Filter achievements tracked in EHI or for **The Secret** -> See progress filter in Achievements Page
- Damage hit markers or Floating health bars
- Hudlist
- etc...

See screenshots in the "Images" tab for more info and how it looks in-game.

EHI is using in-game panels and should be compatible with all HUD mods.
You can change x, y position in options to move it on the screen. The mod supports Ultra-Wide monitors.

**Accuracy**
Always accurate on host.
Clients should stay accurate within 1-3s range. It is recommended to install (on both host and client side players) [Slowmotion Manager](https://modworkshop.net/mod/18128) mod and remove all slowmotion effects that slows down time calculation.
Desync can also disallow some trackers to show up/update. There is nothing to prevent it.
If you drop-in to a heist, some trackers related to elements may not appear. This is because they are not synced when you drop-in. It can be improved, but it is unfixable.

**Trackers**
Some trackers are inaccurate and have orange color. These trackers can prematurely expire or expire late when an element (van, heli, ...) is interactable.

**Supported heists**
All vanilla heists are supported (Under the Hammer Heist (Update 248) is the latest vanilla heist). Custom heists are not supported due to I have to look into the map scripts and find elements that can be tracked. However, support for them may come at later date.

- adding more elements
- modifying existing elements (for example: shortening wait etc...)

EHI fails to recognize these changes and because of that, some trackers may not be accurate as they are in vanilla.
Example mods:

**Compatible mods**

**Incompatible mods**

**How to install**

**Important:**
If you are crashing, always post a crashlog. I'm not a psychic nor I can read your mind and posting similar comments like "EHI is crashing my game, fix it asap" is not helping either.
Without crashlog I cannot help you.

**Feedback**
If the mod is crashing or you have an suggestion, please use the link to my Google Forms [here](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdE2ciCKNroP0o_-SEZWNGhoZNQu8RNRnj45yq0d4a8dwVaDg/viewform)

# SuperBLT Beta for 64-bit PAYDAY 2

This is a beta release of SuperBLT, ported to the 64-bit release of PAYDAY 2.

While most of the functionality is working, a few things aren't finished yet:

* XAudio: **CURRENTLY WORKS**. This is in the process of having the backend be ported to play all audio via the game's native WWise audio engine, but this will not impact how mods work or are made.
* Misc. recent features from the 32-bit DLL: these were lost due to the history of the 64-bit port, which was forked from RAID BLT. Some changes were made to SuperBLT after RAID BLT forked from it, and these haven't been ported forwards yet.
* DLL Plugins: completely untested, may or may not work. No stable API yet.

# Installation instructions

Download the ZIP, and copy the DLL into your game folder. The README.txt file contains instructions on this.

If you are updating from a 32-bit SuperBLT installation, delete the 'base' folder inside the 'mods' folder. This will be automatically re-downloaded when you start the game for the first time.

# Known bugs:
- Alesso heist is stuck at 99% on loading screen.
	- Reason: You don't have BeardLib installed or it's outdated. This happens because the marked doors highlights requires beardlib in order to work.
- Marking cameras disables their highlights.
	- Reason: Unlike enemies and civilians, cameras doesn't have a function to turn low quality when seen from afar, which is what Highlighter requires for working with markable stuff.
- Dragon Heist and Crude Awakening crowbars won't get highlighted unless you get near one.
	- Reason: The game highlights it automatically when you get close to it.
- Prison Nightmare hidden pumpkin will also highlight the trophy in your safehouse.
	- Reason: The files are the same.
- ATMs will stay highlighted even after they're open.
	- Reason: The files are the same.
- Enter The Gungeon statues will also highlight the trophies in your safehouse.
	- Reason: The files are the same.
- The vial centrifuges are not getting highlighted from the start of the heist
	- It only gets highlighted after you trigger the blood samples validation objective and after you get near it for the first time.
- Buluc's Mansion churro will also highlight the churro asset in Breakfast In Tijuana.
	- Reason: The files are the same.
- The White House secret will have your murky uniforms highlighted when you get out of the elevator.
	- Reason: The files are the same.
- The important NPC highlights also adds contour to some useless civilians in a few other heists.
	- Reason: The files are the same.
- The infected patient in No Mercy has only his tattoo highlighted.
	- Reason: Highlighting the patient's whole body would affect all 3 patients. Highlighting only the tattoo points which one is the correct patient.
- Goat Simulator planks won't have the white color.
	- Reason: Only way I've found to make the highlight work with those planks.
- 8th anniversary statue for Rats will only highlight it's base.
	- Reason: Highlighting the whole object would cause texture glitches and keep it unhighlighted.
- A mega sangres mask gift box is not getting highlighted on San Martín Bank.
	- Reason: It spawns inside a white van on the street and will only get highlighted once you open it.
- Some highlights suddenly stops working with items behind walls or at a far distance.
	- Reason: The game either reduces the item resolution or simply despawns it until you're close enough or if it's not obstructed. Despawned items cannot be highlighted.

# FAQ
**Q: Is this mod still getting updated?**
A: Yes. This mod will get updated whenever a new item worth of being highlighted is released. I accept feedback and ideas for new highlights too.

**Q: Does it trigger the cheater tag on me or can I get banned by using it?**
A: No. Comments related to this will be ignored and deleted.

**Q: Can you highlight:**
- safes
- diamond heist saphires display cases
- birth of sky money bundles
- circuit boxes
- goats

A: No. Those items can't get highlighted with the methods I use and each has their own reasons so don't bother asking. Comments related to this will be ignored and deleted.

**Q: Where should I install it?**
A: Read the install instructions tab. Comments related to this will be ignored and deleted.

**Q: Can you make a function to toggle highlights on and off?**
A: No. Comments related to this will be ignored and deleted.

**Q: Can anyone see the highlights?**
A: No. This mod is client sided and will work regardless if you're the host or if you join someone who doesn't have it installed. Comments related to this will be ignored and deleted.

**Q: The mod doesn't work.**
A: The mod works just fine. Comments related to this will be ignored and deleted.
If it doesn't work for you then:
- You installed in the wrong folder.
- You extracted the folders from the .zip file into one folder.
- You didn't read the install instructions tab.

mod.desc:
# SuperBLT Beta for 64-bit PAYDAY 2

This is a beta release of SuperBLT, ported to the 64-bit release of PAYDAY 2.

While most of the functionality is working, a few things aren't finished yet:

* XAudio: **CURRENTLY WORKS**. This is in the process of having the backend be ported to play all audio via the game's native WWise audio engine, but this will not impact how mods work or are made.
* Misc. recent features from the 32-bit DLL: these were lost due to the history of the 64-bit port, which was forked from RAID BLT. Some changes were made to SuperBLT after RAID BLT forked from it, and these haven't been ported forwards yet.
* DLL Plugins: completely untested, may or may not work. No stable API yet.

# Installation instructions

Download the ZIP, and copy the DLL into your game folder. The README.txt file contains instructions on this.

If you are updating from a 32-bit SuperBLT installation, delete the 'base' folder inside the 'mods' folder. This will be automatically re-downloaded when you start the game for the first time.

detail.name: Visual Fixes & Tweaks
detail.desc:
Visual Fixes & Tweaks aims to be the visual counterpart to [The Fixes](https://modworkshop.net/mod/23732). Instead of fixing Lua files, this mod focuses on correcting errors in the game's various textures, materials, and models, with some minor code edits included purely for visual purposes. There are so many fixes packed into this mod that the 20 image limit isn't even enough to showcase them all!

Because this mod aims to improve the entire game, it edits a wide variety of things. Please be cautious, as this mod may conflict with other mods that modify similar files.


Showcase below: *Work In Progress...*

!!!

| Without Visual Fixes | With Visual Fixes | 
| -------- | -------- | 
Fixed the Cavity 9mm equip animation
| ![](https://i.imgur.com/t2TjmvD.gif) | ![](https://i.imgur.com/z5zmaM6.gif) | 
Restored lootbags to how they looked in older versions
| ![](https://i.imgur.com/YzIuF8d.png) | ![](https://i.imgur.com/YhSn51N.png) | 
Fixed security doors missing their material (**GSMA**) texture
| ![](https://i.imgur.com/66mVx3t.png) | ![](https://i.imgur.com/P3pv2TN.png) | 
Fixed the pre-planning icon for Big Bank showing Branch Bank's icon instead
| ![](https://i.imgur.com/1Z7w73f.png) | ![](https://i.imgur.com/X9R6tnI.png) | 
Fixed weapons being absurdly shiny in third person
| ![](https://i.imgur.com/6e6qOpM.png) | ![](https://i.imgur.com/gQnMURT.png) | 
| ![](https://i.imgur.com/isBuM2d.png) | ![](https://i.imgur.com/RtWs9CN.png) | 
Fixed missing materials on weapons
| ![](https://i.imgur.com/F26tBXF.png) | ![](https://i.imgur.com/wb1mfY3.png) | 
Fixed errors and mistakes with cubelights
| ![](https://i.imgur.com/7nc2emA.jpeg) | ![](https://i.imgur.com/0neJnu0.jpeg) | 
| ![](https://i.imgur.com/qjG7iSg.png) | ![](https://i.imgur.com/Ti9GbEE.png) | 
!!!


**Known conflicts:**
* [No Forced Mip Values](https://modworkshop.net/mod/34949) - This mod edits a bunch of material_config files that Visual Fixes also touches, so conflicts are bound to happen. I'd recommend checking which files conflict and deleting the duplicates from either Visual Fixes or No Forced Mip Values.

* Optimized World - This mod was removed from ModWorkshop, but please be wary if you still have it installed. (I'd recommend uninstalling it regardless.)

* Mods that change map environments - A bit of a no-brainer, but just be safe!

* [Correct/Fixed Normal maps](https://modworkshop.net/mod/24922) - This mod fixes some of the same issues Visual Fixes does, and also makes a lot of normal maps more apparent by giving them actual depth rather than leaving them flat. I'd recommend handling it the same way as in the section below!

* [Stop Painting My Stuff](https://modworkshop.net/mod/36338) - Touches up weapon material_configs to stop custom colour skins from being applied to certain parts, many of which Visual Fixes also covers. Should be pretty safe to install alongside, though!

* [HD Money, Loot, & Pickups Mod](https://modworkshop.net/mod/19997) - Causes infinite loading errors due to conflicts with some jewelry material_configs. Aside from that issue, I'd actually recommend this mod!

* [Restoration Mod](https://modworkshop.net/mod/428) - Has some conflicting files with Visual Fixes, but I haven't heard of any infinite loading issues or crashes. Just be cautious.

**Already included in Visual Fixes:**

* [Post-Anniversary Fixed Lootbag](https://modworkshop.net/mod/35431)

* [Better-er Orthogon Parts](https://modworkshop.net/mod/41663)


If you think something is conflicting with this mod, please double-check both mods' files to see if they overlap. **__And PLEASE let me know what mod is conflicting!!!__**



**Highly Recommended Mods alongside Visual Fixes:**

* [The Fixes](https://modworkshop.net/mod/23732) by **andole** & **Dom** - Corrects a lot of base game bugs and crashes. A must-have, think of it as the unofficial patch for PAYDAY 2.

* [Old Deferred Lighting Style Restoration](https://modworkshop.net/mod/32981) by **test1** - Restores the way PAYDAY 2 used to render specular prior to Update 79.

* [Tailor Pack 2 Optimisations](https://modworkshop.net/mod/26764) by **Jarey_** - Downsizes the textures used for Tailor Pack 2 and Pool Repair outfits. The textures alone normally take up 1.3GB, but this reduces them to just 173MB.

* [Stop Painting My Stuff](https://modworkshop.net/mod/36338) by **MrVavlo** - Same reasons as stated in the section above.

* [Correct/Fixed Normal maps](https://modworkshop.net/mod/24922) by **Columbus** - Same reasons as stated in the section above.

* [Weapon Shadows](https://modworkshop.net/mod/38712) by **Hoppip** - Adds shadows to a bunch of weapons that were missing them.

* [AK Correct Magpul Assist (Speed Pull) Mags](https://modworkshop.net/mod/19777) by **>:3** - Makes the speedpull magazine match the corresponding AK variant. For example, you'll keep the waffle magazine if you use the speedpull on a waffle-mag AK, rather than being defaulted to the standard AK Rifle's magazine.

* [Original Bipods](https://modworkshop.net/mod/28543) by **>:3** - Restores some LMGs' original bipods from before Starbreeze forced all LMGs to share the same bipod model.

* [Vanilla Heister Improvement Project](https://modworkshop.net/mod/40378) by **HedyL** - Replaces the dated 2013-era gloves seen in third person on the default suit with the much higher quality first-person gloves. Also includes head mesh tweaks, armour refits, and weighting fixes.

* [Default Gloves Replace Wrinkle Gloves](https://modworkshop.net/mod/32514) by **Nelson01023** & **Dorpenka** - Replaces the "Wrinkled Gloves" with the Criminal Gloves used in first person.

* [Better Sleeves & Fixes](https://modworkshop.net/mod/34542) by **Dorpenka** - Makes first-person sleeves from outfits a consistent length, and fixes a lot of weighting issues with them.

* [Glove Tweaks](https://modworkshop.net/mod/38976) by **Dorpenka** - Fixes various glove issues, including model corrections and texture tweaks for a nicer overall look.

* [MSFE - Mask Straps Fit Everyone](https://modworkshop.net/mod/52592) by **White_3Designer** - A neat mod that gives each heister a unique mask strap model to fit their head shape.

* [Extended Para Foregrips](https://modworkshop.net/mod/48604) by **linuskall01** - Extends the rails on Para SMG foregrips so your hands aren't floating while holding the weapon.

* [3D Weapon Rails](https://modworkshop.net/mod/53714) by **linuskall01** - Gives some weapons actual 3D rails rather than relying on normal map trickery.

* [Weapon Texture Reworks](https://modworkshop.net/mod/36505) by **Gambyt** - Improves the visuals of various weapons, including fixes for 2020 to 2024 era weapons.

# SuperBLT Beta for 64-bit PAYDAY 2

This is a beta release of SuperBLT, ported to the 64-bit release of PAYDAY 2.

While most of the functionality is working, a few things aren't finished yet:

* XAudio: **CURRENTLY WORKS**. This is in the process of having the backend be ported to play all audio via the game's native WWise audio engine, but this will not impact how mods work or are made.
* Misc. recent features from the 32-bit DLL: these were lost due to the history of the 64-bit port, which was forked from RAID BLT. Some changes were made to SuperBLT after RAID BLT forked from it, and these haven't been ported forwards yet.
* DLL Plugins: completely untested, may or may not work. No stable API yet.

# Installation instructions

Download the ZIP, and copy the DLL into your game folder. The README.txt file contains instructions on this.

If you are updating from a 32-bit SuperBLT installation, delete the 'base' folder inside the 'mods' folder. This will be automatically re-downloaded when you start the game for the first time.

detail.name: Gilza - Weapon and skill rebalance
detail.desc:
:::

### Originally inspired by [IREnFIST](https://modworkshop.net/mod/28585) 

:::

Payday 2 is one of my favorite games, despite how poorly balanced it is. I have accumulated over 6k hours at this point, and this mod in particular i have started working on all the way back at ~3k hour mark.

This ~~small~~ rebalance is what i have come up with, to make a game that i already enjoy, even more enjoyable. At least for me.


-----

:::
### Welcome to Gilza
:::

:::
A Payday 2 weapons/skills/perks rebalance/overhaul. 
(FYI - "Gilza" is a Russian word for "Bullet casing")
:::

#### What is this mod about?

As the title suggests - it changes most skills, perks and all weapons of Payday 2. All changes made by this mod are only available to the player who has it installed, without affecting gameplay for other players. It works in online lobbies regardless of if you are client or host.

#### How difficult is this mod?
This rebalance is {#eb4034}(not trying) to make the game easy. It was made by me - for me, and i consider myself a pretty decent FPS player. If you think of yourself as an average/casual player, you may find some (mostly weapon) tweaks too difficult for you.

#### Main goals of this mod:
* Make **__ALL__** weapons equally viable across all difficulties - this includes nerfing over-performing weapons.
* Update damage altering skills to make players rely on damage buffs less often.
* Provide players with more fun skill/perk combinations for improved build variety.
* Make every skill and perk useful/less situational.

-----


:::
### {#00CCC1}(Rebalance info summary)
:::

Detailed information on [skill](https://github.com/irbizzelus/random-noncode-stuff/blob/main/Gilza%20txts/General_and_Skills.md), [perk](https://github.com/irbizzelus/random-noncode-stuff/blob/main/Gilza%20txts/Perks.md) and [weapon](https://github.com/irbizzelus/random-noncode-stuff/blob/main/Gilza%20txts/Weapons.md) changes can be found on pages dedicated to them. (Perk page includes recommended builds)  
On this page you may find a short summary for some of the rebalance changes of this mod.


#### Stealth
99% of the rebalance changes of this mod are focused on loud gameplay, and the perk page does not provide any examples for stealth builds. If you are planning on playing in stealth, there are only a few things to note, compared to vanilla:
!!!
* Basic "Stockholm Syndrome"'s civilian intimidation bonus was moved to tier 2 skill "Confident" in the same tree, making it 1 point more expensive
* Tier 1 and 2 skills in Shinobi sub tree of Ghost were shuffled around a little. Keep these changes in mind if your Shinobi sub-tree is usually not maxed out
* Consider running new "Parkour" aced skill on some maps, and maybe even a doctor bag along with it.
* "Burglar" perk deck's stealth bonuses were buffed from 10-20% to 25%
* "Hacker"s PECM cooldown was increased from 100 to 150 seconds (Hacker is still better than Burglar, since it can help clear up mistakes, but the choice is a little bit less one sided now)
!!!


#### Enemy changes
All enemies now have same amount of health on all difficulties, with values being similar to vanilla Death Wish difficulty.  
Headshot multipliers are now set to 2x for most enemies, with exceptions for some special enemies.

#### Melee rework
Melee weapons now deal % damage - if your melee has 35 damage, it will deal 35% of enemy's total health in one hit. Some enemies take reduced damage, to avoid melee weapons one-shot'ing everything.

#### Skills/Perks
Detailed skills info page can be found [here](https://github.com/irbizzelus/random-noncode-stuff/blob/main/Gilza%20txts/General_and_Skills.md).
Detailed perks info page can be found [here](https://github.com/irbizzelus/random-noncode-stuff/blob/main/Gilza%20txts/Perks.md). This page includes at least 1 recommended build for every perk deck for loud gameplay, in case you don't want to go through all the changes Gilza makes in one go.

__Default upgrades/changes__ 
- By default, regardless of equipped skills, perks and weapons, all weapon swap speeds are sped up by 50%. This is done to incentivize players to use both of their weapons proactively more often, as Gilza's ammo economy is extremely harsh if played otherwise.
- Ammo pick up rates for standard and throwable weapons now scale with equipped armor (suit/ictv etc), with bigger armors providing more ammo per pickup. This should help low movement armors with ammo pickups.
- While hosting a lobby (either online or offline) Team AI bots will now drop less ammo boxes from their kills. Every kill they get now has a 25% chance to drop ammo whenever you have 3 bots, 50% at 2 bots, and 75% at 1 bot. This only affects Team AI, and does not affect converts and sentries. This should make ammo accessibility in offline games feel close to online games, so that the disparity between the 2 would not be as drastic.

__Global - damage resistance__ 
All damage resistance upgrades are now additive instead of multiplicative. For more info you can go to the skills info page, under general section.

__Skills__
Extent of skill changes is too vast to sum up, so you should check the "Skills Legend" picture bellow, which summarizes skill rework information - if a skill was updated or not, and how significantly. Check out whatever you think might be interesting on the skills info page :)

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/irbizzelus/random-noncode-stuff/refs/heads/main/Gilza_pics/Skill_Images/Skills%20legend.jpg)

__Perks__
Most perks received minor updates to improve their design (mostly for DS difficulty), with only 3 perks gaining "major" reworks. Don't forget to go over general (or "neutral") perk deck cards on the perk page, since they apply to all perks, and by extension to all builds.  
Additionally, 3 new custom perks were added - "Brawler", "Speed Junkie" and "Guardian".

#### Weapon Changes

Detailed weapon info page can be found [here](https://github.com/irbizzelus/random-noncode-stuff/blob/main/Gilza%20txts/Weapons.md).

__Damage and ammo:__
All guns are now categorized under a "damage class" - all weapons have a strict starting damage value, which are all based around specific breakpoints (aka amount of bullets to kill certain enemy types). This makes both balancing and gun building easier to manage.  
Ammo pick up is now dependent only on weapon damage class, and it is __much much__ worse (roughly 65% of what you would have in vanilla). You **HAVE** to use both of your weapons, and *even then* you can still run out, especially on lengthy heists. Using melee and throwable weapons is somewhat mandatory, to avoid running out of ammo quickly.

For example, Galil ("Gecko 7.62" in game) deals 67 damage in vanilla. If you take into account a maxed out perk deck, you will deal ~70.3 damage on a bodyshot and ~263.8 on a headshot with it in vanilla (based on Death wish difficulty health/headshot multipliers), which means this weapon will kill a light swat in 2 headshots and a heavy swat in 4 headshots, while having an average ammo pick up of ~10.04 (with any maxed out perk deck).
In Gilza a similar damage class exists - 125. With it, you will also kill a light swat in 2 headshots and a heavy swat in 4 headshots, but this damage class has ~6.44 ammo pick up on average, forcing you to be more accurate with it and to use your other weapons.

__Recoil:__
Most guns have more recoil.
Recoil camera compensation is almost completely removed.
Weapon recoil now depends on your base stability: weapons with low base stability will have extremely high recoil, and vice versa.

__Handling:__
Weapon accuracy and stability are no longer affected if you: crouch, jump, walk or sprint. However, both accuracy and stability have a penalty if you are firing from the hip. Aiming down sights removes this penalty.
All weapons have an accuracy penalty if used in full-auto and burst fire modes. If you use the select fire keybind to switch weapon to single-fire mode, you weapon will gain it's full accuracy.

__Bipods:__
Implemented "Battlefield 5 style" bipod mounting system where the bipod is automatically placed when player is close enough to a valid surface. To reduce frustrations this deployment method prevents certain limitations that bipods normally have in vanilla, like camera limits, ability to interact with items, and moving.

Bipods video preview:
!!!
![](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y8_BJ50YIng)
!!!

{#eb4034}(__**IMPORTANT**__): for your first try of the mod make a backup of your save files.  
If you dislike the mod and choose to remove it, it will __not__ have any issues, and it will __not__ corrupt your save files, BUT you might lose some weapons from your inventory, due to updates in their attachment data.
Also your perks can get reset. Perk reset DOES NOT remove how many perk points you have (points you use to unlock perks), but it might remove your progression, and leave you with all perks at 0/9, forcing you to go through all of them while holding the + button. (use R (default keybind) while on the perks screen to max out a perk quickly).

{#eb4034}(__**EVEN MORE IMPORTANT**__): if you are going to give Gilza a try, check all mods that Gilza requires to function, under "Dependencies and Instructions". All mods that are tagged as "optional" are sorted in order of importance, from highest at the top to lowest at the bottom. I recommend getting everything before (but preferably also including) FrenchyAu's weapon attachment packs.


{#eb4034}(__**Last thing**__): don't immediately try to play this mod on whatever difficulty you usually prefer, maybe try to play it on a difficulty bellow that for a game or two, as some aspects of Gilza could be a bit too difficult initially.

P.S Gambler rework is the most fun one in my opinion :D

# Custom Weapons Support

This mod will automatically search for custom weapons and convert their damage stats to work with Gilza's health changes. Beware: some custom weapons may have attachments that change damage/ammo pick up/total max ammo, or other stats in such a way that it will not match Gilza's values well, making them either too good, or bad. I can't do anything about that, other than __manually__ adding support for __every gun individually__, and that will take time. You may find a list of weapons that are currently supported on the [weapon info page.](https://github.com/irbizzelus/random-noncode-stuff/blob/main/Gilza%20txts/Weapons.md#custom-weapons-support)

Custom "special" category weapons are not supported by the automatic stat adjustment system, but may be added later individually, check the currently supported list to see if they are already supported.

# Additional QOL features

* VanillaHud+'s buff list is supported for all major skill updates that Gilza makes, allowing for easy tracking of new skills' cooldowns and such.
* While charging your melee weapons new melee UI will appear showing your charge amount and damage in %. This can be tweaked or disabled in Gilza's mod options.
* You can set up a keybind in Gilza's mod options for a "melee only" toggle mode. While in this mode the game automatically charges melee weapons for you, and makes primary attack button the trigger for melee swings. You can cancel this mode by using the same keybind or melee attack button. Additional options, like position of this mode's HUD indicator, it's size and location are also accessible in Gilza's mod options.
* You can disable camera tilt while charging melee weapons to reduce motion sickness if you extensively use melee (like with the new Brawler perk deck). This can be tweaked or disabled in Gilza's mod options.
* You can reset your perk progression to re-acquire perk decks, allowing you to try new custom perk decks without grinding XP to unlock them. This option does not reset amount of perk points you have already earned.
* Vehicle FOV was changed from base 75 to 90 - you can change it in mod options in game.
* While purchasing weapons on the blackmarket, they can now be sorted by their damage classes, either in ascending or descending order. This option can be disabled.
* You can spoof Gilza's custom perks, to avoid getting auto kicked in higher difficulty public lobbies, since some players are purists and can not comprehend any rebalance mods. This option can be disabled in Gilza's mod options.

# Known issue:
You can crash when entering a heist, while using Jackal SMG or one of the Chimano pistols, with certain attachment combos, or while using the Kang arms model 54 pistol. This can only happen with weapons that you have modified/purchased before installing Gilza, due to updates in their attachments data. Simply re-purchase them if you run into this issue.

# Included mods
* [Auto Fire Sound Fix](https://modworkshop.net/mod/20403) - needed for rate of fire adjustments for some weapons, and for some new skills. Thanks to [Offyerrocker](https://modworkshop.net/user/offyerrocker) for allowing this.
* Various WeaponLib crashes and bugs (like shotgun damage) are fixed by Gilza.
* [Akron HC set sound fix](https://modworkshop.net/mod/41269) - Another mod of mine that fixes sounds for this weapon if you have Auto Fire Sound Fix, and since Gilza comes with AFSF it only makes sense to add this too. 


# Compatibility
Gilza can detect *some* mods that it may conflict with on it's own, and will give you a warning pop up after loading into the main menu. Otherwise:
* Payday 2 VR is __not__ supported.
* Custom perks are __not__ supported as they will conflict with existing neutral perk card changes.
* Any other skill/perk/weapon changing mods will either break the balance, won't work correctly or straight up crash your game, so avoid those.
* Custom weapons are supported, but aren't perfect unless weapon was manually altered by me to work with Gilza's stats. For list of those go to the [weapon](https://github.com/irbizzelus/random-noncode-stuff/blob/main/Gilza%20txts/Weapons.md) page.

# Supported languages (depends on your SuperBLT's language):
- English
- Russian - а именно описания всех навыков, перков, оружий, элементы HUD'а и меню. Некоторые элементы могут быть на английском - если найдете что-нибудь не переведенное, пишите в комменты.

Enjoy figuring out your new META and please provide feedback if something feels way too powerful or underwhelming.
Good luck and have fun! :D

:::
## 2.8.12
:::

### Compatibility with update 248 and new content:

!!!
- Updated stats on newly added shotgun, it will match a pump action shotgun damage class and will have highest base rate of fire of them all, while having worst total ammo capacity and stability. All attachments were made more polarizing.
- Arbiter grenade launcher now deals 4.2% more damage to targets with 500 health to match vanilla's behavior where this weapon now can one-shot light SWAT with direct hits.
- Added newly added vehicle to the FOV adjustment list.
- Fixed a WeaponLib bug that was causing the reloads on the new shotgun to not function properly (hopefully this did not break reloads on other weapons)
- Fixed an issue where having an unknown to Gilza weapon added to the game without using beardlib (like a new vanilla DLC weapon), while having 0 custom weapons installed, was crashing the game on startup.
- Fixed an issue where custom melee weapons with certain stats could not appear in the melee selection screen.
!!!

### Other:
- Shotguns now have roughly 20% more ammo pickup by default, but all ammunition options now have higher ammo pickup penalties with the end pickup value being the same as before this patch. This should make default shotgun ammunition a more appealing choice and allow for greater build variety, as skills that deal with body armor and shields can now be valuable on default round shotguns.
- Total ammo increase on the 000 Buckshot ammunition on shotguns was reduced from +25% to +15%.
- VHUD+ indicator for bloodthirst will now have correct "basic" and "aced" text indication based on the upgrade used.

:::
# Previous patches
:::

!!!

2.8.11

This patch includes technical updates and bugfixes. Fixes that may alter balancing are listed first.

### Balance altering updates:
#### Weapons
- Akimbo pistols/SMGs - fixed an issue where only one weapon was firing per trigger pull.
- Saw - fixed issues with damage not being correctly applied to non-Bulldozer enemies if "Body Expertise" skill is used. Updated description.

#### Skills
- "Underdog" (and all the perks that rely on this trigger) - line of sight check was updated to be more optimal and is now updated 25 times a second instead of 10. LOS check itself will now check for enemy's head positions instead of their center mass. LOS check will no longer be stopped if a different enemy is blocking the LOS to the enemy that skill is trying to check against - this should make enemies that stand in a line still trigger this check. Due to increased consistency the lingering duration of the skill might be reduced bellow 5 seconds in a future update, need more playtesting for now.
- "Swan Song" - movement penalty is now constantly disabled while other allies are downed instead of being applied periodically and for a set duration. Downed TeamAI now also disable the movement speed penalty. Updated description.

#### Perks
"Leech":
- Fixed an issue that was causing the player to heal for more than the intended 50% health if they revived another player during the ampule effect duration.
- Invulnerability period will now prevent melee and explosive damage from damaging the player.

"Hitman":
- Will no longer try to select a bounty target if the perk was upgraded to have the "Death Dance" combo, but wasn't upgraded yet to have the bounty system.
- Bounty target will now be prioritized to be at a certain range away from the player (~14m). Previously it was trying to find a target as close as possible to the player.

### Other fixes

#### Skills
- "Backfire" - fixed an issue where this skill would prevent "Shockwave" from causing staggers on nearby enemies.
- "Tower Defense" - fixed an issue where picking up destroyed sentry guns would still refill ammo to the player.

#### Perks
"Copycat":
- Fixed an exploit with weapon swapping that allowed for weapons to have carried over ROF from the weapon they were swapped away from.

"Leech":
- Fixed random issues where the game could miss-calculate player's health ratio.

#### Other
- VHUD+ will no longer log errors when the "instant weapon swap" upgrade from copycat is activated.
- Fixed localization errors.
- Removed some deprecated code.

# 2.8.1

This patch requires a full game restart.

## Global
- Fixed a VHUD+ compatibility bug that was causing enemy AI issues while hosting games in rare scenarios.
- Fixed compatibility issue between VHUD+ and WeaponLib which prevented "interaction circle for weapon reloads" option in vhud+ from working.

### Damage resistance
- Maximum possible damage resistance reduced to 60% while playing on Death Wish and lower difficulty contracts.
- Maximum possible damage resistance reduced to 75% while playing on Death Sentence difficulty contracts.
- If a single skill provides more damage resistance than the maximum allowed damage resistance, it will now override the maximum DR cap. For example - if you get revived by a player with the "Painkillers" skill, the 80% damage resistance bonus that it provides will now be applied to you even if the maximum damage resistance you can normally have is 60%.

## Skills
- "Fearmonger" - fixed an issue where the skill would spread panic while holding a valid shotgun, but using other weapons to kill enemies (like throwables, sentry guns or trip mines).
- "Heavy impact" reworked - new name: "Shockwave". Instead of staggering the enemy that user is shooting at, the stagger is now applied to enemies in the radius around the hit target. This should reduce frustrations of missing the enemy's head due to them staggering while you are shooting at them, and also create a decently powerful "area of effect" crowd control skill, most useful for lower damaging weapons due to the fact that the stagger chance is rolled per hit. To limit the power of this skill, since its only a tier 2 and relatively cheap, limitations were added to weapons that it can be used with, and the stagger chance was reduced relatively to previous values of Gilza's heavy impact. Stagger is also limited to 1 enemy per initial hit to prevent constant enemy stuns (i'm not trying to make cooldown-less Hacker over here).
- "Lock N' Load" - weapon swapping no longer resets reload bonuses, and these bonuses are now saved until the weapon starts to reload. To compensate ease of use and to incentivize using this skill with bigger magazine weapons, kill requirement was increased to 5. Fixed an issue where the skill would count kills while holding a valid weapon, but using other weapons to kill enemies (like throwables, sentry guns or trip mines). Fixed an issue where non valid weapons were allowed to gain bonuses from the skill (like fully automatic pistols).
- "Equilibrium" - Basic version now provides full 50% swap speed bonus with pistols, and now provides a new 10% movement speed bonus while holding pistols. Aced version - now provides 16 pistol accuracy (was 12), and provides a 100% faster ADS speed bonus with pistols, while also making the 10% movement speed bonus apply to the player if pistol is equipped, instead of requiring the player to hold it.
- "Gun Nut" reworked - new name: "Swift Hands". Basic version allows for quicker reloads with pistols, which this skill previously provided in Aced version, but at reduced rate (was 50% in Aced, now 30% in Basic). Aced version - new upgrade which allows to reload your primary weapon while holding a secondary pistol. Hitting enemies with the secondary pistol speeds up the reload of the primary weapon.
- "Trigger happy" - bonus to pistol's rate of fire reduced from 30% to 25% to compensate higher base ROF with all pistols.
- "Bottomless pockets" - fixed an issue where SMGs and Pistols received different total ammo bonuses (previously SMGs were getting less total ammo than skill description promised). Total ammo capacity bonus reduced from 50%(Basic)-150%(Aced) to 30%(Basic)-80%(Aced). Previous values for this skill made more sense when this skill was first added about a year ago, when most SMGs and pistols had less total ammo (especially akimbo versions). Now that these weapons were rebalanced to have more ammo by themselves, the total ammo bonus does not need to be as high anymore, so it was compensated with this nerf. Total ammo capacity with most affected weapons is still about the same as it was when this skill was added.

## Perks
- "Sicario" - "Twitch" perk card cooldown reduced for every armor by ~15-33%.

## Weapons
- Updated descriptions for LMGs to include enemy piercing info.
- Reduced ammo pickups globally by ~2% for all weapon types.
- Readjusted all AP kits added by Gilza (including attachments that were converted into AP kits) - they will now have a more similar, relative to each other, total ammo reduction penalty, which scales with ammo pickup penalty. The ammo pickup penalty was slightly nerfed for most AP kits. Accuracy/stability stats on some AP kits were adjusted.

### Pistols
- Rate of fire for all pistols was increased by ~25%. Maximum total ammo for all pistols increased by 50%. Skills affecting pistol's rate of fire and total ammo were nerfed to compensate these changes.
Why?:
Pistols were in a really good spot for a long time in Gilza, but only as a primary weapon when you invest into their skills, while using pistols without their skills was underwhelming. These changes should flat out this disparity and make pistols feel better on their own without a huge skill point investment, while keeping maxed out pistols relatively the same.
- Kahn .357 revolver: stability increased from 4 to 32. Hex cylinder magazine attachment stability bonus changed from +12 to -12 stability.
- Matever .357 revolver: total ammo increased from 36 to 42. (54 to 63 for akimbo)

### Assault Rifles
- Increased ammo pickups for 200, 155, and 125 damage classes by ~5-10%.
- Total ammo increased for Galant and M308 to match 450 damage class assault rifles. Their stability was increased from 36 to 72 to compensate their lower rate of fire.
- Galant: ammo pouch attachment concealment reduction nerfed from -1 to -3.

### SMGs
- Increased ammo pickups for 200, 155, 125 and 100 damage classes by ~5-10%.

### Grenade launchers
- Reduced ammo pickups by ~10%.
- Increased reload speeds for both primary grenade launchers, especially for GL40.

### Miniguns 
- Can now pierce through multiple enemies by default. Ammo pickup reduced by ~8%.

### Shotguns
- "HE round" ammunition - ammo pickup penalty nerfed from 45% to 60%.

# 2.8

This patch requires a complete game restart for skill changes to properly apply.

### Global
- Increased ammo pickups across all weapons by ~12%. LMG's received a slightly smaller pickup increase of ~8%.  Sniper rifles have had their pickups completely redone.
- Armor's ammo pick up multipliers reduced slightly for all armors lighter than the Heavy Ballistic Vest.
- Bulldozers now take 50% damage from explosive bullet sources. This was done to compensate recent vanilla rocket launcher rework after which bulldozers started taking double damage from explosive sources, causing explosive bullets to deal more damage than intended. This should only affect HE shotgun ammunition.
- Fixed a WeaponLib bug which prevented ammunition with weapon muzzleflash overrides from applying said muzzleflash effect. (for example Dragon Breath rounds on shotguns, or the Sting grenade on grenade launchers)

### Skills
- Reworked "Graze" skill (for the 3rd time) to provide a still appealing, but much less effective skill option which should still help hit collateral shots much easier, while reducing it's effectiveness if used with Assault Rifles and SMGs (unless additional damage skills are applied). Instead of creating damage zones in which enemies take reduced damage, damage is now reduced after every new enemy hit, but the Graze radius now also expands after each new enemy hit. Fixed issues with wall recognition where graze would pass through any wall.
- Fixed an issue where "Shotgun Expert" skill's accuracy bonus was not applying correctly.
- Reworked aced "Lock N' Load": instead of providing a reload speed based on bullets remaining in the weapon magazine, it now instead increases the reload speed bonus based on amount of bullets fired. Removed limitation where first 15 bullets from the magazine did not count towards the reload bonus. Bullets fired during infinite ammo buffs now count towards the reload bonus. The basic reload bonus now starts at 10% instead of 35%, to compensate changes above. Additionally this skill now provides an ammo return mechanic, where hitting enemies in quick succession will refund bullets directly into the weapon magazine, without consuming reserve ammo, making it a new ammo and magazine capacity improving skill.
- "Body Expertise" aced will now also deal it's 125% bonus damage if enemy is hit in the head. This was done to make it more consistent, and to allow for better variety with builds that may rely on bullseye for survival. As funny as it was to deal more damage to the enemy body than their heads, it lead to unintuitive and unfun gameplay.
- "Bloodthirst" basic and aced versions swapped around places. Damage stacking changed from 20% to 40% per kill and max stack count from 10 to 5, to make max damage easier to achieve, since this skill now costs more. Reload skill's duration reduced from 10 to 6 seconds, and reload speed bonus reduced from 50% to 35%, to make it make more sense for it's new cost.


### Perks
- Removed "Rogue's" 9th card 5% passive dodge chance (5% crouch dodge untouched). Since the previous "Revitalized" skill rework "Rogue's" effectiveness has improved too drastically relative to other dodge decks, so the max possible dodge was reduced.
- Reduced "Hacker's" bonus dodge after 3 PECM kills from 20 to 15, and increased it's duration from 45 to 50 seconds. Similarly to "Rogue", effectiveness of this deck was way too high relative to other dodge options. The duration was increased to make max dodge maintainment easier.
- "Grinder": fixed vanilla inconsistencies with damage over time activation, where this perk was not allowed to gain regeneration from certain actions, such as flashbang and electric grenade stuns, and shooting friendly converted cops, while other on-damage perks could.
- "Ex-president" rework 2.0: Card 1) Instead of always removing stored health on armor regen, ex-president will now instead reduce stored health by required healing first, and then by 48 health points on top. With this change, if after armor break player does not take damage, the stored health will only get reduced partially, making upkeep of stored health easier, especially with lower end armors that normally can hold a large quantity of health. Card 9) Armor recovery bonus: instead of losing the bonus on armor recovery, it will now only get reset whenever stored health was consumed, which similarly to the card 1 change, should make maintaining of max bonuses easier if the player does not take any health damage after armor break. "Copycat Ex-president" did not receive any of these changes.
- "Anarchist": fixed a vanilla issue where sentry guns did not activate the on-damage armor regeneration skill. Updated on-damage armor recovery cooldowns and armor amounts regenerated while using: 2-piece suit, LBV, BV, HBV making them regen slightly less often but in slightly bigger armor chunks - overall armor per minute remains the same. ICTV armor's armor per minute amount was slightly increased both from passive regen and on-damage effect.
- "Speed Junkie": adrenaline spike requirement in the 70+ stacks range nerfed by increasing it from 30 to 40 seconds.
- "Brawler": 9th card's armor gating nerfed by increasing partial regeneration delay from 1 second to 2 seconds, while keeping total armor and total duration amounts intact.
- "Copycat-Brawler": armor gating nerfed by increasing partial regeneration delay from 1 second to 2.5 seconds. Max duration of the effect reduced from 10 to 8 seconds, while armor regeneration amount per stack remains the same.

### Weapons
- 95 damage class updated to 100 without adjusting the ammo pickup, to make it function better with crits and/or Body Expertise without requiring an investment of 5 damage from attachments.
- Sniper ammo pickups: 650 and 950 increased by ~8-10%, 1300 reduced by ~8%, 1600 and higher reduced by ~15%. These changes were done due to effectiveness of these weapons if paired along with the new "Graze" skill, as higher damaging snipers were extremely effective with it, while requiring no additional skill investment, while lower damaging snipers were just straight up nerfed by this rework.

#### SMGs
- Added AP ammunition options to following SMG's: Patchett L2A1, Signature, Mark 10.
- Signature: reduced stability by 8, increased accuracy by 12, buffed one of the FrenchyAU pack's weapon stocks to provide positive reload bonus instead of negative for better attachment variety.
- Kobus90: AP bullets' accuracy decrease buffed from -20 to -16.

#### Shotguns
- Tombstone slug reworked - instead of dealing flat 250 damage, it now deals an extremely low % of enemy's health, with extremely short intervals between damage ticks. Added guaranteed enemy stagger on hit. Added multi-enemy penetration. Added 50% chance to pierce body armor. Added damage drop off buff of 20%. Pellet amount reduced to 6. Removed total ammo adjustments.
- AP slug ammo pickup penalty buffed from 25% to 20%, total ammo cut buffed from 25% to 20%, range increase buffed from 20% to 50%.
- 000 buckshot ammo pickup nerfed from 20% to 25%.
- Dragon's breath fire trigger distance reduced from 16 to 14 meters, added said range to the ammo description.
- HE round's ammo pickup penalty nerfed from 40 to 45%, maximum explosive range reduced from 2m to 1.5m. Damage against bulldozers reduced by 50% to compensate recently added damage vulnerability they received against explosives.

# SuperBLT Beta for 64-bit PAYDAY 2

This is a beta release of SuperBLT, ported to the 64-bit release of PAYDAY 2.

While most of the functionality is working, a few things aren't finished yet:

* XAudio: **CURRENTLY WORKS**. This is in the process of having the backend be ported to play all audio via the game's native WWise audio engine, but this will not impact how mods work or are made.
* Misc. recent features from the 32-bit DLL: these were lost due to the history of the 64-bit port, which was forked from RAID BLT. Some changes were made to SuperBLT after RAID BLT forked from it, and these haven't been ported forwards yet.
* DLL Plugins: completely untested, may or may not work. No stable API yet.

# Installation instructions

Download the ZIP, and copy the DLL into your game folder. The README.txt file contains instructions on this.

If you are updating from a 32-bit SuperBLT installation, delete the 'base' folder inside the 'mods' folder. This will be automatically re-downloaded when you start the game for the first time.

detail.name: Bullet Offset
detail.desc:
Adds bullet offset so that bullets actually come from your gun instead of your face. 
Yes, the Payday gang have been spitting bullets at their enemies all this time. (They have been shot enough times to canonically do this)

**Preview gifs available under images!**
The bullet offset is dynamic with the weapon viewmodel using the fire_obj marker to position and rotate bullets. 
Forward offset is disabled, since it could cause you to shoot through walls if you are too close.

-Bullets actually follow weapon lasers!
-Height over bore is a thing now! No more pixel peeking over obstacles with high mounted optics. 
-Left side peeking is disadvantageous! Unless you've flipped your viewmodel or are dual wielding!
-Weapons shoot where they are actually pointing! Cancel-shooting an inspect animation will shoot wherever the gun is pointed.
-Shooting around corners is possible!

The bullet offset is only really noticeable for around 5-10ish meters, then bullets generally follow their normal trajectory.

Possible problem with akimbo offset: the left gun does not posses a fire_obj marker, to get around this we just flip the offset of the right gun, this might lead to problems with unsymmetrical weapon animations(vanilla ones are all symmetrical)  

I highly recommend [Tactical Leaning](https://modworkshop.net/mod/22254) by [Offyerrocker](https://modworkshop.net/user/offyerrocker) to go with this mod, as they compliment eachother quite well.

I made this because all my other  favorite shooter games have this feature and it absolutely ruined my aim without it.

Mod is at a minimal setup loading directly from main.xml instead of a mod.txt, this makes the mod a bit smaller, and also allows you to either put the mod in the mods folder or the mod_overrides folder.

**Note about WeaponLib and broken akimbo weapons**: Current WeaponLib has broken akimbo weapons. Both guns are supposed to shoot one after another once per click but with the current WeaponLib, only the right gun shoots once per click. v1.1 of my mod is compatible with this and makes the bullet spawn alternate between right and left gun. 
If you want akimbo weapons to work properly you need [Weapon Lib Akimbo one bullet fix + Improved Single/Burst Fire input](https://modworkshop.net/mod/58880) by [I AM GREEN](https://modworkshop.net/user/iamgreen) and v1.2 of my mod.

detail.name: PiP Scopes v1.3
detail.desc:
**Thanks to Diesel 3.0/64bit update, the previsouly VR-exclusive feature of PiP (Picture-in-Picture) scopes can now be ported into the flatscreen game without much hassle.**

---

### What the mod does:
 - Makes every "scope" in the game Picture-in-Picture - drawing a separately rendered zoomed image inside the scope
 - Lowers the standard camera-FOV-zoom when entering ADS to the default vanilla minimal (same as angled sights, etc)
 - Removes the Y-axis of the so-called "stance_mod" for "Sniper Scopes" - when removing the camera-FOV-zoom, it is noticeable that the gun shifts dramatically backwards with those, so that the camera sits inside the scope
 - Implements PiP for some newer scopes that were lacking it (Z5 Owl Glass, CASSIAN Sharp, CASSIAN Elite) - for both VR and non-VR
 - Falls back to regular behavior for Custom Scopes that don't support PiP
---

###  Mod Options:
 - **Scope Resolution:** resolution scaling of the in-scope picture
 - **Anti-Aliasing:** use anti-aliasing (smooth out pixelated edges) for the in-scope picture
 - **Zoom Multiplier:** global multiplier of the scopes' zoom level
 - **Keep "FOV Relative Sensitivity":** makes the ''FOV Relative Sensitivity'' setting still think your FOV is zoomed in when using a scope
 - **PiP "Combat Sight":** toggle this OFF if you want a bit of realism for the ''Combat Sight'' that shouldn't have optical magnification. Works in VR too
---

### Some notes/issues:
 - Unavoidably performance-heavi**er**, primarily GPU-wise. detail.name: Emma NIKKE Battle Announcer
detail.desc:
Tell me, what ties a squad of 3 elite military personnel together? Is it the fearless leader that rallies them to certain victory or the silent one that has a fetish for killing literally everything that moves? You'd be surprised to know that it's neither of them. It's the one that looks out for the others' health with a good heart. Her name is Emma. She doesn't restrict her aid to her squad, she's about willing to help with anything whether it's giving a message that melts fatigue away or using oils to keep stamina up. There is one thing she loves doing that no one else can bring up about her. She loves cooking, despite her dishes being something that came from aliens. Best to keep her away from the crystal lab too, lord knows she'd blow it up instantly. She has 46 voicelines she can say, each having an equal chance of being played. Some lines are taken from her Color Me Red costume. Those are indicated with a (C), respectively. Specifically, 

-----
When an enemy is killed (10 sec cooldown):
"Let's fight together."
"Get serious, OK?"
"I ought to punish you, heeheehee!"
"Nice."
"Neat."
"Done."
"Now Commander!"
"I'll give you my full attention. Heehee!"
"All together now!"
"Let's give it everything we got."
"On my way!"
"Battle engaged."
"Let's have a good time while we're out there, okay?" (C)
"Let's score another one for the good guys." (C)
"Let's finish quickly so we can get back to the party." (C)
"Hahahahaha." (C)
"We did it!" (C)
"I'll keep doing my best!" (C)
"All set, Commander." (C)
"Everyone, hang in there!" (C)
"Shall we get started?" (C)
"Off to battle we go!" (C)
"I'll try my best and work just as hard as you." (C)

-----
When the player takes damage (15 sec cooldown):
"Cover me!"
"I'll take my chance."
"Reloading as soon as I can."
"Ugh!"
"Gah!"
"Uh..."
"Do you need... some therapy?"
"Come over here. I'll keep you warm." (C)
"My outfit is too short... it's a bit inconvenient." (C)
"Hang in there, Commander." (C)
"Aghh!" (C)
"Ack!" (C)
"My hat!" (C)

-----
When a heist ends in success:
"If we work together, this'll be a walk in the park."
"We're getting closer don't you think? I feel it too."
"Everyone in the squad is precious to me, but you're the most special of all. Wait, why do I think that?"
"I'll make you feel better... Every part of you."
"Whoo, it's over! Now we can go party!" (C)
"Now that we've changed into something more comfortable, would you like to go on a date?" (C)
"It's a little cold in here... Can I sit beside you?" (C)
"I don't know why, but I feel like spending this Christmas with you and nobody else. Do you feel that way too?" (C)

-----
When a heist ends in failure:
"Sorry... I need to take a rest."
"Sorry Commander, but I'm going to go rest for a while..." (C)

-----

detail.desc:
With a team, there's usually 3 roles you can take on. Attacker, defender, or supporter. Out of those 3, being a supporter doesn't have a straightforward way to grow further. An attacker can deal more damage, attack faster/more frequently, or find an alternate source of damage. A defender can strengthen defenses, provide counter attacks, or work in tandem with the attacker. A supporter can focus on other objectives for the team or provide additional firepower, but that seems to be it on the surface. However, with a tactical upgrade, Emma can now disperse special liquids in her outfit for specific situations. One of these liquids can act as a disruptor for communication devices and doubles as they relay information back to Emma. Certainly, an underrated feature for a support role.

-----
When an enemy is killed (10 sec cooldown):
"Well then, shall we face it together?"
"I'll make sure they don't move an inch."
"Alright everyone, let's relax and get started."
"That was great. Hehe."
"It's done."
"Nothing to worry about."
"Liquid solution at the ready."
"Here you go! A little therapy for everyone."
"C'mon, everyone, let's all attack together!"
"If you need cover fire during battle, leave it to me."
"Enemy spotted. Should we engage?"
"If you need anything, just let me know, okay?"

-----
When the player takes damage (15 sec cooldown):
"Hang on just a sec."
"Sorry, this is taking a while, isn't it?"
"I just need a short break to reload."
"Ahh!"
"Oh my!"
"Eek!"

-----
When a heist ends in success:
"You did great, Commander. Did you like the new scent?"
"You seem a bit worn out, Commander. Here, lay your head on my lap. I've been studying a new kind of therapy."
"Anytime you want to relax, you can always come to me."
"Vesti, Eunhwa, and you are all precious to me, Commander. But with you, it feels a little more special somehow."

-----
When a heist ends in failure:
"I'm sorry, Commander... I might have overdone it..."

mod.desc:
# BeardLib
A large library that assists in mod creation for PAYDAY 2.
- Custom Heists
- Adding files easily
- Multiple modules to make mods without writing any code
- Easy ability to add content. Such as masks, melee weapons, weapon mods, suits, gloves and more
- Script File Manipulation

## Download
You can download a stable release from modworkshop: https://modworkshop.net/mod/14924

`Note:` BeardLib versions 5.1.0 and above only support Diesel 3.0 / 64 bit.

## Dependencies
* [SuperBLT](https://modworkshop.net/mod/58342)

## Documentation
The main documentation can be found on the [wiki](https://luffyyy.gitbook.io/beardlib)

## Templates
You can find them here: https://github.com/diesel-modding/BeardLib-Templates

* [PD:TH HUD](https://modworkshop.net/mod/19900)

* And a lot more on [ModWorkshop](https://modworkshop.net/g/payday-2/mods?selected-tags=11)

mod.desc:
# SuperBLT Beta for 64-bit PAYDAY 2

This is a beta release of SuperBLT, ported to the 64-bit release of PAYDAY 2.

While most of the functionality is working, a few things aren't finished yet:

* XAudio: **CURRENTLY WORKS**. This is in the process of having the backend be ported to play all audio via the game's native WWise audio engine, but this will not impact how mods work or are made.
* Misc. recent features from the 32-bit DLL: these were lost due to the history of the 64-bit port, which was forked from RAID BLT. Some changes were made to SuperBLT after RAID BLT forked from it, and these haven't been ported forwards yet.
* DLL Plugins: completely untested, may or may not work. No stable API yet.

# Installation instructions

Download the ZIP, and copy the DLL into your game folder. The README.txt file contains instructions on this.

If you are updating from a 32-bit SuperBLT installation, delete the 'base' folder inside the 'mods' folder. This will be automatically re-downloaded when you start the game for the first time.
